aliases.description: A list of aliases to create. Note - due to the use of `toset()`, values must be static strings and not computed values

aliases_use_name_prefix.description: Not supported: an alias name with a random suffix (name_prefix) would change between renders

bypass_policy_lockout_safety_check.description: A flag to indicate whether to bypass the key policy lockout safety check. Setting this value to true increases the risk that the KMS key becomes unmanageable

computed_aliases.description: A map of aliases to create. Values provided via the `name` key of the map can be computed from upstream resources

create.description: Determines whether resources will be created (affects all resources)

create_external.description: Not supported: imported key material (aws_kms_external_key, aws_kms_replica_external_key) has no kind: ACK's Key takes origin EXTERNAL, but nothing imports the material

create_replica.description: Determines whether a replica standard CMK will be created (AWS provided material)

create_replica_external.description: Not supported: imported key material (aws_kms_external_key, aws_kms_replica_external_key) has no kind: ACK's Key takes origin EXTERNAL, but nothing imports the material

custom_key_store_id.description: ID of the KMS Custom Key Store where the key will be stored instead of KMS (eg CloudHSM).

customer_master_key_spec.description: Specifies whether the key contains a symmetric key or an asymmetric key pair and the encryption algorithms or signing algorithms that the key supports. Valid values: `SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT`, `RSA_2048`, `RSA_3072`, `RSA_4096`, `HMAC_256`, `ECC_NIST_P256`, `ECC_NIST_P384`, `ECC_NIST_P521`, or `ECC_SECG_P256K1`. Defaults to `SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT`

deletion_window_in_days.description: Not supported: ACK's Key has no field for the waiting period before deletion (KMS's default, 30 days, applies)

description.description: The description of the key as viewed in AWS console

enable_default_policy.description: Specifies whether to enable the default key policy. Defaults to `true`

enable_key_rotation.description: Specifies whether key rotation is enabled. Defaults to `true`

enable_route53_dnssec.description: Determines whether the KMS policy used for Route53 DNSSEC signing is enabled

grants.description: A map of grant definitions to create

is_enabled.description: Specifies whether the key is enabled. Defaults to `true`

key_administrators.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key administrators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-default-allow-administrators)

key_asymmetric_public_encryption_users.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key asymmetric public encryption users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-users-crypto)

key_asymmetric_sign_verify_users.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key asymmetric sign and verify users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-users-crypto)

key_hmac_users.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key HMAC users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-users-crypto)

key_material_base64.description: Not supported: imported key material (aws_kms_external_key, aws_kms_replica_external_key) has no kind: ACK's Key takes origin EXTERNAL, but nothing imports the material

key_owners.description: A list of IAM ARNs for those who will have full key permissions (`kms:*`)

key_service_roles_for_autoscaling.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/key-policy-requirements-EBS-encryption.html#policy-example-cmk-access)

key_service_users.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key service users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-service-integration)

key_spec.description: Not supported: imported key material (aws_kms_external_key, aws_kms_replica_external_key) has no kind: ACK's Key takes origin EXTERNAL, but nothing imports the material (key_spec is the external key's)

key_statements.description: A map of IAM policy [statements](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/iam_policy_document#statement) for custom permission usage

key_symmetric_encryption_users.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key symmetric encryption users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-users-crypto)

key_usage.description: Specifies the intended use of the key. Valid values: `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT` or `SIGN_VERIFY`. Defaults to `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT`

key_users.description: A list of IAM ARNs for [key users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policy-default.html#key-policy-default-allow-users)

multi_region.description: Indicates whether the KMS key is a multi-Region (`true`) or regional (`false`) key. Defaults to `false`

override_policy_documents.description: Not supported: merging other policy documents into the key policy by statement sid is not ported yet; write the whole policy in policy, or the statements in key_statements

policy.description: A valid policy JSON document. Although this is a key policy, not an IAM policy, an `aws_iam_policy_document`, in the form that designates a principal, can be used

primary_external_key_arn.description: Not supported: imported key material (aws_kms_external_key, aws_kms_replica_external_key) has no kind: ACK's Key takes origin EXTERNAL, but nothing imports the material

primary_key_arn.description: The primary key arn of a multi-region replica key

region.description: Region where the resource(s) will be managed. Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration

rotation_period_in_days.description: Not supported: ACK's Key has no rotation period field (enable_key_rotation is supported, with KMS's default period, 365 days)

route53_dnssec_sources.description: A list of maps containing `account_ids` and Route53 `hosted_zone_arn` that will be allowed to sign DNSSEC records

source_policy_documents.description: Not supported: merging other policy documents into the key policy by statement sid is not ported yet; write the whole policy in policy, or the statements in key_statements

tags.description: A map of tags to add to all resources

valid_to.description: Not supported: imported key material (aws_kms_external_key, aws_kms_replica_external_key) has no kind: ACK's Key takes origin EXTERNAL, but nothing imports the material
